div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 520px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Person
A human user
of the system

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 520px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Software system
In scope: the system
being described

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 520px; text-align: center;

span.p:
External system
Out of scope:
depended on,
not built here

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 520px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Container
An application that
must be running for
the system to work

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 520px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Data store
A container that
holds data: a database
or a file tree

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 520px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Component
A grouping of code
inside one container

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 520px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Step
One numbered step
of a dynamic diagram

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 520px; text-align: center;

span.p:
───────▶
Solid arrow: a labelled,
one-way relationship;
between processes it
names the protocol

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 520px; text-align: center;

span.p:
─ ─ ─ ─ ▶
Dashed arrow: not an
always-on call, but an
alternative chosen by
configuration or a
manual step
